body:
Pass 16. C6 closure verified independently - all of it holds. Bitwise identical values and signatures across 16 MiB / 64 MiB / 512 MiB / 4 GiB. Correct against a base-R oracle (qr.resid + crossprod) to 8.5e-14 and 1.1e-13 on magnitudes of 100-140, i.e. floating-point exact. df = 145 = n - rank. Pair set exactly the 310 upper-tri nonzeros of the union pattern. Padded reader used exclusively so the boundary hazard is handled, and budget refusal fires before source reads with a useful message.

No new findings - nothing is wrong this pass.

Epic 5 is yours now; metric.R was hot so I left it. When the derived-precision path settles I will check that the metric inherits the same cross-budget bitwise property, since that is where the conditioning amplification from the original C6 argument actually bites.
